title: Automate artifact provenance & staged profile publishing for versioned models
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Create a CI/CD workflow that builds model artifacts reproducibly, produces verifiable provenance (signed attestations, SBOMs), runs standardized performance benchmarks, and publishes performance profiles to the model catalog via a staged (canary -> gradual) rollout. The pipeline must emit immutable artifact metadata (model hash, container digest, build recipe), attach SLSA-style attestations signed by a KMS/HSM-backed key, and store artifacts and profiles in the artifact registry with ACLs. Key requirements: 1) Reproducible builds with pinned build env and recorded toolchain versions. 2) Automatic perf benchmark run that outputs a signed performance profile and quality/regression metrics. 3) Gate logic: publish to catalog only if perf & quality thresholds pass; otherwise attach failed-profile metadata and notify stakeholders. 4) Staged publishing: automatic canary publish (small % traffic or internal host group), then promote to GA after health/telemetry checks. 5) Metadata updates: update model version pins in the onboarding index and emit a change event for routing/console. 6) Security: ephemeral signing keys, periodic rotation, audit logs, and policy to require manual approval for externally-trained or high-risk models. 7) Observability: dashboards and alerts for publish failures, regression triggers, and rollback events. Implementation plan: a GitHub Actions prototype for lightweight models and ArgoCD/tekton for heavy builds; artifacts stored in our registry (s3-backend + DynamoDB index) and perf profiles published to the catalog service.
acceptance_criteria: Automated build produces reproducible artifact digest and SBOM
Attestation signed by KMS is attached to artifact metadata
Perf benchmark job runs in CI and outputs signed performance profile JSON
Failing quality/perf thresholds prevent catalog publish and open a blocking ticket
Canary publish auto-promotes to GA after configurable health checks
Model catalog entry is updated with version pin and profile reference
Audit trail records artifact sign/publish/promote events
risks: Long-running perf jobs will increase CI costs; need batching and quota
Attestation key compromise risk: require HSM and rotation policies
False negatives from perf drift could block valid models without easy override
Cross-team coordination required (runtime, infra, security, devex)
implementation_notes: Prototype uses GitHub Actions for build + small perf runs, uploads artifacts to staging registry. A follow-up step will migrate heavy workloads to Tekton pipelines on k8s. Use sigstore for initial attestations; integrate KMS->HSM signing in second phase. Perf benchmark harness will reuse existing runner infra used by ENG-4729 and ENG-5891. Add policy config in catalog service to support canary percentages and health-check windows.

notes: This ticket intentionally separates attest/sign from the final HSM integration: initial rollout uses sigstore with OIDC-based ephemeral keys for speed, later gated HSM for certified publishes. We must ensure the catalog and routing layers can consume the profile schema (versioned) and that pinning metadata is backwards compatible with older runtime clients.
